description: Moverse en bicicleta en Sant Feliu de Llobregat is a dataset listed in IDEE, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by santfeliu.cat. Getting around by bike in Sant Feliu de Llobregat is a set of geographical information represented in an interactive viewer on a Google Maps cartographic background. We find spatial information related to the circulation of bicycles in the city. We can consult two cartographic archives: free parking and bike lanes in Sant Feliu de Llobregat. Coverage: ES. The portal shows the English title as "Get around by bike in Sant Feliu de Llobregat" (machine-translated by the portal). Its keywords include Senda cíclica, Municipio, Aparcamientos, Aparcament, Bicicleta, Cycle path. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-idee.
